Drednaw

Water Rock

Galar · Generation 8

Drednaw is a Water/Rock-type Bite Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 115.5 kg. It evolves from Chewtle. Its highest base stat is Attack (115), with a base stat total of 485.
